article_title: Chinese runner dropped by sponsor after riding bike in marathon

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A marathon introduced bicycles for runners who became unwell.
A Chinese fitness influencer lost a sponsorship after admitting she used a bicycle during the Berlin Marathon.
A sports brand cancelled all of its contracts with online influencers.
Berlin Marathon organisers changed the route after incorrect split times.
tasks.correct_answer: A Chinese fitness influencer lost a sponsorship after admitting she used a bicycle during the Berlin Marathon.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בסון יואניואן, שהודתה כי רכבה על אופניים במהלך מרתון ברלין ובעקבות זאת איבדה את החסות של Brooks.

tasks.prompt: Which company ended its sponsorship deal with Sun Yuanyuan?
options: OMTIU
Rednote
Brooks
Berlin Marathon
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חברת נעלי הריצה Brooks הודיעה שסיימה את ההתקשרות עם סון לאחר שבדקה את העובדות.

tasks.prompt: In Brooks's statement, what does “integrity” most nearly mean?
options: The ability to run very fast
The popularity of a sports brand
The accuracy of a GPS device
Honest behaviour and strong moral principles
tasks.correct_answer: Honest behaviour and strong moral principles
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר של ערכי ספורט כמו הוגנות וכבוד, integrity פירושו יושר והתנהגות מוסרית.

tasks.prompt: What evidence did the monitoring account OMTIU publish?
options: A photograph that appeared to show Sun on a bicycle between 35km and 40km
A video of Sun leaving the race before the start
A statement from Brooks approving the shortcut
A GPS record showing she completed an extra five kilometres
tasks.correct_answer: A photograph that appeared to show Sun on a bicycle between 35km and 40km
tasks.explanation_hebrew: OMTIU פרסם תמונה שנראתה כמציגה את סון על אופניים בקטע שבין 35 ל־40 קילומטר.

tasks.prompt: Why did Sun's unusually fast 35km-to-40km split raise suspicion?
options: It showed that she had started the race too slowly.
It proved that the official course was shorter than advertised.
It matched the part of the course where she appeared to use a bicycle.
It meant that all her earlier split times were missing.
tasks.correct_answer: It matched the part of the course where she appeared to use a bicycle.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההאצה החריגה התרחשה באותו קטע שבו התמונה הצביעה לכאורה על שימוש באופניים, ולכן חיזקה את החשד לקיצור דרך.

tasks.prompt: What does “concealed” mean when Sun said she deliberately concealed what she had done?
options: Repeated publicly
Kept hidden
Explained clearly
Forgot completely
tasks.explanation_hebrew: concealed פירושו הסתירה או שמרה בסוד; סון הודתה שלא גילתה בכוונה את השימוש באופניים.

tasks.prompt: What consequences did Sun face after the incident became public?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות שתי תוצאות מרכזיות: פסילת זמן הסיום שלה, סיום החסות של Brooks, והביקורת הציבורית שבעקבות החשיפה.
expected_points: Berlin Marathon organisers disqualified her finishing time.
Brooks terminated its sponsorship agreement with her.
She faced public criticism after the evidence and her admission were shared online.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the suspected rule-breaking was discovered and confirmed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לקשר בין פרסום התמונה וה־splits על ידי OMTIU, הודאתה של סון, ותגובות המארגנים והספונסר.
expected_points: OMTIU highlighted a photograph and an unusually fast split between 35km and 40km.
Sun admitted on Rednote that she had used a bicycle and hidden it.
The race organisers disqualified her result.
Brooks verified the facts and ended the sponsorship.

tasks.prompt: Why would an athletics sponsor treat this incident as a serious breach rather than a minor mistake?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהשימוש באופניים העניק יתרון לא הוגן, הוסתר בכוונה, ופגע באמינות התוצאה ובערכי היושר, ההוגנות והכבוד של הספורט.
expected_points: Using a bicycle gave an unfair advantage in a running event.
Sun said she deliberately hid the rule-breaking.
The conduct undermined trust in the result and in the athlete's public claims.
Brooks explicitly linked its decision to integrity, fairness and respect.

tasks.prompt: Write a short statement Sun could give to runners that accepts responsibility without making excuses.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התגובה צריכה לכלול הודאה ברורה, הכרה בפגיעה בהוגנות, התנצלות וקבלה של ההשלכות, בלי להצדיק את המעשה בשל מצבה הגופני.
expected_points: Admit using the bicycle and hiding the action.
Acknowledge that feeling unwell did not justify breaking the rules.
Apologise for disrespecting other runners and the sport.
Accept the disqualification and sponsorship consequences.
